content: Melvin-Koushki says the only textual sources Ibn Turka admits into the Mafāḥiṣ, his systematization of Akhlāṭī's oral teachings, are Ibn ʿArabī's Futūḥāt and Saʿd al-Dīn Ḥamuvayī's K. al-Maḥbūb (with Jābir b. Ḥayyān's K. al-Khamsīn quoted in the introduction as well), and that he identifies the earlier high-water mark of lettrism with those two authors' writings.
